warehouse.name: Warehouse
checklist: Every open issue has one owner on the next shift.
Equipment out of service is tagged and listed.
Safety incidents and near misses are written down.
Docks, aisles and fire exits are clear.
The next shift lead has read this handover and asked questions.
warehouse.headsUp:
e.g. Volume peak expected at 11:00
Forklift 3 in repair until Thursday

hotel.name: Hotel front office
checklist: Every guest issue has an owner and a promised time.
Cash and card terminals are balanced and counted.
Late arrivals and special requests are listed.
Rooms out of order are reported to maintenance.
Keys, safes and master keys are accounted for.
The next shift has read this handover and asked questions.
hotel.headsUp:
e.g. VIP arrives 23:30, room 412
Fire alarm test at 10:00

delivery.name: Delivery station
checklist: Every returned parcel is scanned and has a reason.
Vehicle damage and defects are reported with photos.
Missing drivers and open routes are known to dispatch.
Keys, scanners and fuel cards are back and counted.
Customer escalations have an owner and a callback time.
The next shift has read this handover and asked questions.
delivery.headsUp:
e.g. Road closure on the B43 from 06:00
Two new drivers start on routes 14 and 15
